properties.name: CORRECTION to this decision's "CHEAP" line: `--call` does build the served list (main.rs:750), but on ReflowService::in_memory(), an empty design. So it holds every schema and NO lessons. A `--describe` that printed that list would pass a shape test while dropping exactly the half that is L6
properties.statement:
FROM THE 2026-10-02 TRIAGE (agent B), idea I5 of art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02. The report's idea 5 IS this decision, settled 2026-10-01 as step 4 of the door plan, so no new idea was minted. This finding adds three measured points for whoever builds req:the-cli-describes-any-tool-with-its-full-schema-and-lessons.

1. THE PROBE IS EMPTY. The rationale says "CHEAP: --call already builds the served list with lessons (tools_with_lessons, main.rs ~750)". In code (origin/main 66620f7), main.rs:750 calls tools_with_lessons on `ReflowService::in_memory()`, and that (service.rs:6348) opens `DesignGraph::open_in_memory()`. lessons_by_step over an empty graph returns nothing.
   - So the probe's list has the schemas and no lesson.
   - The listing must be built from the OPENED store, as list_tools builds it, to carry the 218 lessons measured on reflow2's own design (fact:root-cause-tool-lessons-reach-only-tools-list-and-no-door-reply-carries-one-2026-10-02).
   - A held store can be read from the snapshot the door already uses for read-only tools.
2. NESTED SHAPES LIVE IN $defs. 16 of 195 tools carry them (35 required nested fields), for example RelationLinkReq, ChecksumAcceptReq and AffectedNodeReq. The describe must print `$defs` with the schema, not only `properties`. A cheat-sheet generator that flattens properties loses exactly the shapes the report says are learned by refusal.
3. A TEST THAT WOULD HAVE CAUGHT POINT 1: describe a tool that a scratch design hangs a lesson on, and assert that the lesson's id appears. A shape-only assertion passes against the empty probe.

Recorded as an observation on the decision, not a change to it. The status is untouched.
